events.comment: Sprint intent is just LShift. Speeds are owned by the state machine and smoothed in 'speed smoothing'.

parameters: HeadPOS.CenterX() + cos(ToRad(CamX)) * (LeanBlend * 40 + cos(BobPhase * 0.5) * BobAmp * 0.6 + cos(TimeFromStart() * 1.1) * (1 - 0.7 * MoveBlend))
HeadPOS.CenterY() + sin(ToRad(CamX)) * (LeanBlend * 40 + cos(BobPhase * 0.5) * BobAmp * 0.6 + cos(TimeFromStart() * 1.1) * (1 - 0.7 * MoveBlend))

(HeadPOS.Object3D::CenterZ() + (Player.Object3D::CenterZ() + 80) * 3) / 4 - AdvancedMathTools::Ease("sineInOut", CrouchBlend) * 45 - abs(LeanBlend) * 5 + sin(BobPhase) * BobAmp + sin(TimeFromStart() * 1.5) * 1.2 * (1 - 0.7 * MoveBlend) - LandDip

events.comment: Camera banking: strafe roll while sprinting, lean tilt, bob sway, grab/carry sway, plus a turn-bank from mouse yaw speed. CamRoll follows its target with a damped Spring (slight natural overshoot).

parameters: CamRollMax * CamRollStrafe * Sprinting * (0.35 + 0.65 * MoveBlend) + LeanBlend * CamRollLean + sin(BobPhase) * 0.35 * MoveBlend * Sprinting + CamRollGrab * CamRollGLat * CamRollGrabAct + CamRollCarry * CamRollCarryF * sin(BobPhase * 0.5) + CamTurnRoll
